title: Dutch braid of 3 (ABOK 2966), 4 gears, 6 passes
notes:
Words are read over one pass of the card. The card, a column a gear, two lines a step — the gears turning anticlockwise ↺, then clockwise ↻ — ● punched:
     A B C D
0 ↺  ○ ○ ○ ○
  ↻   ○ ● ○ ○
1 ↺  ○ ○ ● ○
  ↻   ○ ○ ○ ○
Made move by move, as on a marudai: 7.6 yarn diameters long.
